extracted.intended_audience: PR professionals in Italy; prospective FERPI members; institutions engaging with PR sector
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of FERPI (Federazione Relazioni Pubbliche Italiana) membership eligibility, professional/ethical expectations, institutional roles, territorial presence, and legal/transparency information. Targets prospective members and stakeholders interacting with the association.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible member professional roles
rubrics_metrics.description: I soci FERPI operano come liberi professionisti, dirigenti, funzionari, dipendenti e collaboratori di aziende, enti pubblici, Enti del Terzo Settore, docenti universitari. Partecipano alla vita di FERPI anche studenti e neolaureati.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists the professional profiles that constitute FERPI membership (freelancers, managers, officials, employees, collaborators across private/public/third-sector, university lecturers) and explicitly includes students and recent graduates as participants in association life.

rubrics_metrics.name: Membership application and professional activity requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Possono iscriversi alla Federazione tutti coloro che presentano domanda ed esercitino attività professionale di Relazioni Pubbliche in proprio, in associazione con altri o alle dipendenze di datori di lavoro.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To join one must submit an application and actively practice public relations work either independently, in association, or as an employee; membership is contingent on demonstrated activity in the PR field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Civil rights and professional conduct requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Sono richiesti il pieno godimento dei diritti civili e politici e una condotta professionale etica.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prospective members must enjoy full civil and political rights and maintain ethical professional behavior; ethical conduct is an explicit membership requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered association status and guarantee of professional/deontological capacity
rubrics_metrics.description: inserita nell’elenco delle associazioni professionali non organizzate in ordini o collegi del MISE - Ministero dello Sviluppo Economico (legge 4/2013) ed è garante delle capacità professionali e della deontologia dei propri iscritti nei confronti del mercato
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FERPI's registration under MISE (law 4/2013) positions it as a guarantor of its members' professional competences and deontological (ethical/professional) standards toward the market; implies oversight/validation responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Role as institutional interlocutor
rubrics_metrics.description: interlocutore delle istituzioni centrali e locali e di tutti i soggetti che concorrono alla definizione delle attività, degli strumenti, delle norme che regolano il sistema della comunicazione
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FERPI acts as a representative and interlocutor with central and local institutions and other stakeholders in defining activities, tools, and regulations governing the communication system; membership implies representation by the association in policy/dialogue.

rubrics_metrics.name: International association membership and standards alignment
rubrics_metrics.description: socio fondatore di Global Alliance for Public Relations and Communication Management e membro di Euprera (European Public Relations Education & Research Association)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FERPI's founding/membership roles in international PR organizations signal alignment with international professional and educational standards and networks; members are part of those broader connections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Territorial delegations and member support
rubrics_metrics.description: presente sul territorio con 12 Delegazioni territoriali per supportare i soci nella loro attività e di promuovere la diffusione della cultura della comunicazione
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FERPI maintains local delegations (12) to support members' activities and promote communication culture regionally; indicates expectation of local engagement and available local services/representation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency: legal registration and contact information
rubrics_metrics.description: Sede operativa: Centro Direzionale Milano Due ... Tel. 3270481762 info@ferpi.it  Registrazione Tribunale di Milano 7604/2025  Sede legale: Via Madre Cabrini, 10 20122 Milano P.IVA 10651340159 C.F 80076230152
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page publishes operational and legal contact details, tribunal registration, VAT and tax codes — a transparency/legitimacy signal and practical requirement for stakeholders and potential members to verify and contact the association.
